primary_fixed_rest: Every other input stays at working; do not automatically sample all input bounds.
access_rule: Run each package separately with identical quantiles/common random numbers. No invented probabilities for package mix. Never resample conversion or net fractions on top of a package. Net fraction uncertainty is commercial rebate uncertainty, not an efficacy pricing multiplier.
structural_rule: Run one structural variation at a time around primary; no Cartesian product. Same sampled draws. Delay shifts clinical decisions and Ekterly stock horizon.

dependence_modes.primitive_independent: Independent primitive quantiles only; shared derived rates, source anchors, joint stocks and access package preserve structural dependencies. Not a claim of empirical independence.
dependence_modes.commercial_rank_linked: Same quantile for commercial family below; upper dependence stress, not fitted correlation.

clinical: Keep marginalIR/XR90%, sharedgate95%primary. Enumerate four states exactly per commercial draw; probabilities applied once. Report expected-value uncertainty AND state-weighted shareholder-outcome distribution separately.

market_reference.rule: No probability of positive/negative stock return until a verified dated market-price input and horizon are supplied.

compute_plan.runtime_rule: Benchmark pilot before expansion; cache identical draw/scenario results, no per-draw source retrieval or narrative. If projected batch exceeds10minutes, optimize/reuse branch arrays and report timing before bulk run. Do not substitute a fitted response surface without held-out error checks.
compute_plan.convergence_rule: Compare512and1024usingprefixseedsequence; continueonlyifquantile movements or MonteCarloerror justify. Draw count reduces simulation error, not assumption error.
compute_plan.outputs: Save compact draws and input hashes; avoid per-month every-draw JSON.
